description: This file defines the class 'ModifyFeatureProperties', which implements a command to modify properties of a feature in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances, parsing from JSON, accessing feature ID and properties, and serializing the command payload.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureProperties
classes.description: Final class representing a command to modify properties of a feature within the Eclipse Ditto framework. Implements methods for command construction, JSON serialization/deserialization, and property access.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of ModifyFeatureProperties with specific ThingId, feature ID, properties, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a ModifyFeatureProperties instance from a JSON string or object, along with headers.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ThingId associated with this command.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Returns the FeatureProperties to be applied.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the feature being modified.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the properties, considering the schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path indicating the resource affected by this command.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends command data to a JSON object builder, considering schema version and predicate.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command (MODIFY).

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified DittoHeaders.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether the command affects authorization (returns false).
